root.label: Mullin responds to Mamdani over ICE shooting

events.label: Mullin responds to Mamdani over ICE shooting

slots.name: U.S. duration
slots.sentence: He said Belgal may have been in the U.S. for the past three years, during which he participated in “extensive criminal activity.”

slots.name: arrest count
slots.sentence: “Really? The men and women of ICE each day are enforcing the laws that he refuses to enforce,” Mullin said. “We arrest thousands weekly that are criminals, going after the worst of the worst, and he turns a blind eye to it.”

slots.name: officer leave
slots.sentence: He said ICE was not aware that the child was in the car during the encounter and that the officers involved will be put on administrative leave while it investigates the situation.
